summary.en: The same squares move from one chart into the next: they change colour in place, then fly group by group on arcs and land with one pulse.
summary.zh: 同一批方块从一张图走进下一张：先原地变色，再按组沿弧线飞过去，落地轻轻一胀。

fits: Any change of chart over the same counted items: grid to bands, bands to a sorted grid, bands to period columns, to an axis, to a closing rule.
notFor: Charts of different items, or of measures that are not counts (a square must stay one item).

intent.en: The same items move from one chart into the next, so the viewer trusts that every chapter counts the same things.
intent.zh: 同一批方块从一张图飞进下一张图，观众因此相信每一章数的都是同一批东西。

content.en: A counted set as groups (2–9, name ≤ 14 chars / 6 字, count) and the two layouts it flies between (grid, sorted, bands, share, periods, axis, rule).
content.zh: 一个分组的计数集合（2–9 组，名称 ≤ 14 字符 / 6 字，带数量），以及它在两种布局之间飞（网格、排序、分带、占比、时期、轴、尺）。

fits.zh: 同一批被计数的东西换一张图：网格到分带、分带到排序网格、分带到时期柱、到轴、到收尾尺。

notFor.zh: 不同东西的图，或不是计数的量（一个方块必须始终是一件东西）。

pairs.note: the layout it most often flies into
the closing light once the squares have landed

en: Never add or drop a square between layouts.
Over about 2,000 squares the flight turns to noise; count a larger unit.
zh: 换布局时一个方块都不能增减。
超过约 2000 个方块，飞行就成了噪点；改数更大的单位。

overlaps.note: unit-regroup migrates dots on springs through clusters, columns and the digits of the total; unit-flight marks rounded squares in place, then flies them group by group on arcs between the tally layouts (bands, periods, axis, rule)

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
